description: Whether a disk is in standby, from the whole disks below its mount, without waking any of them. A whole disk with no spindle spins; so does one that completed I/O since the last check, or has requests under way, by its counters (block_stat.json), and nothing is sent to it. Any other is asked its power mode (power_mode.json), unless it gave no answer before, which leaves it unknown, as does no answer now. Unknown counts as spinning. The disk is in standby when one of its whole disks answers standby.

cases.note: an SSD has no spindle: it spins, and is asked nothing
I/O since the last check: it spins, and is asked nothing
no I/O since the last check: asked, and asleep
no I/O since the last check: asked, and spinning
the first check has no earlier count: asked
counters that cannot be read: asked
whether it has a spindle cannot be read: it counts as one that has
no answer: unknown, which counts as spinning
a disk that gave no answer once is asked no more
two disks below one mount: one asleep is enough, as a read may need it
two disks below one mount, both spinning
